read: I sense a sweaty, eager crowd craving a sing‑along anthem before we dive back into deep house grooves.

tracks.title: Show Me Love
tracks.why: Familiar house classic, sparks movement and nostalgic smiles.
tracks.transition: Low‑pass filter out, beat‑match into indie anthem.

tracks.title: Mr. Brightside
tracks.why: Universally known chorus, ignites communal singing.
tracks.transition: Drop to four‑on‑the‑floor, introduce progressive synths.

tracks.title: Strobe
tracks.why: Long, evolving build lifts energy after vocal climax.
tracks.transition: Filter sweep up, fade into Daft Punk anthem.

tracks.title: One More Time
tracks.why: Celebratory vocal loop, perfect crowd chant moment.
tracks.transition: Cut to acapella intro, segue to tropical remix.

tracks.title: Higher Love (Kygo Remix)
tracks.why: Nostalgic vocals with fresh dance vibe, re‑energizes.
tracks.transition: Bring down filter, ramp up to peak BPM.

tracks.title: Losing It
tracks.why: High‑octane closing, ensures room stays buzzing.
tracks.transition: End with final drop, let room melt.
